title.en: Check which HTTP version a site uses
title.hinglish: Check karo site kaunsa HTTP version use karti hai

why.en: A site that offers HTTP/3 advertises it in an alt-svc header; the browser then switches to QUIC on UDP 443.
why.hinglish: Jo site HTTP/3 deti hai woh ise alt-svc header mein advertise karti hai; phir browser UDP 443 par QUIC par switch karta hai.

expect.en: Response headers that include a line like 'alt-svc: h3=":443"; ma=2592000'. The exact value and headers vary over time.
expect.hinglish: Response headers jisme 'alt-svc: h3=":443"; ma=2592000' jaisi line ho. Exact value aur headers waqt ke saath badal sakte hain.

title.hinglish: curl se seedha HTTP/3 try karo

why.en: Forces a QUIC connection so you can see the one-round-trip handshake happen.
why.hinglish: QUIC connection force karta hai taaki tum ek-round-trip handshake hota dekh sako.

expect.en: A response starting with 'HTTP/3 200' or a redirect. This works only if your curl was built with HTTP/3 support; otherwise curl says the option is not supported. Windows curl.exe usually lacks it, so use Wireshark or a browser there.
expect.hinglish: 'HTTP/3 200' ya redirect se shuru hone wala response. Yeh sirf tab chalta hai jab tumhara curl HTTP/3 support ke saath bana ho; warna curl kehta hai option supported nahi hai. Windows ka curl.exe aam taur par ise support nahi karta, wahan Wireshark ya browser use karo.

title.en: Watch QUIC traffic leave your machine
title.hinglish: Apni machine se QUIC traffic nikalte dekho

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter on QUIC packets.
why.hinglish: Lesson ki .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur QUIC packets par filter lagao.

expect.en: UDP datagrams to port 443: a 1200-byte Initial, Handshake packets, then short-header 1-RTT packets.
expect.hinglish: Port 443 ko UDP datagrams: ek 1200-byte Initial, Handshake packets, phir short-header 1-RTT packets.

why.en: Initial packets are the only ones whose contents Wireshark can decrypt without secrets, so you can read the ClientHello.
why.hinglish: Initial packets hi aise hain jinka content Wireshark bina secrets ke decrypt kar sakta hai, isliye tum ClientHello padh sakte ho.

expect.en: The client Initial (with the TLS ClientHello and SNI) and the server Initial (with the ServerHello).
expect.hinglish: Client Initial (TLS ClientHello aur SNI ke saath) aur server Initial (ServerHello ke saath).
